queries.name: session-membership-counts
queries.sql: SELECT s.slug AS session_slug, COUNT(m.id)::integer AS membership_count FROM legislative_sessions s LEFT JOIN memberships m ON m.session_id=s.id WHERE s.slug IN ('2021-2022','2023-2024','2025-2026') AND ($1::text = 'all' OR s.slug = $1::text) GROUP BY s.slug ORDER BY s.slug LIMIT 3

queries.name: evidence-item-count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS evidence_item_count FROM evidence_items
